## Guardrails

Для каждого guardrail из плана считаем относительное изменение treatment vs control и сравниваем с порогом. Direction `max` — нарушение если изменение превысило +порог, `min` — если опустилось ниже −порог.

guardrails = {{guardrails_py_objects}}

guardrail_results = []  # Sprint 7 ADR-015: read by export-cell
for g in guardrails:
    col = g['name']
    if col not in df.columns:
        guardrail_results.append({'name': col, 'breached': False, 'value': None, 'status': 'column_missing'})
        continue
    means = df.groupby('variant')[col].mean()
    base = means.get('control', None)
    trt = means.get('treatment', None)
    if base is None or trt is None or base == 0:
        guardrail_results.append({'name': col, 'breached': False, 'value': None, 'status': 'no_data'})
        continue
    rel = (trt - base) / base * 100
    breached = False
    if g['direction'] == 'max' and rel > g['threshold']:
        breached = True
    if g['direction'] == 'min' and rel < g['threshold']:
        breached = True
    guardrail_results.append({
        'name': col,
        'rel_change_%': round(float(rel), 2),
        'threshold_%': g['threshold'],
        'direction': g['direction'],
        'breached': bool(breached),
        'value': round(float(trt), 6),
    })

import pandas as pd
display(pd.DataFrame(guardrail_results))

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plottable = [g for g in guardrail_results if g.get('value') is not None]
if plottable:
    names = [g['name'] for g in plottable]
    values = [g['value'] for g in plottable]
    breached = [g['breached'] for g in plottable]
    colors = ['#f87171' if b else '#a3e635' for b in breached]
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, max(2, len(names) * 0.6)))
    bars = ax.barh(names, values, color=colors)
    ax.set_xlabel('value')
    ax.set_title('Guardrails (✓ ok / ⚠ breached)')
    for bar, b, val in zip(bars, breached, values):
        marker = '⚠' if b else '✓'
        ax.text(val, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height() / 2, f' {marker} {val:.3f}', va='center', ha='left')
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
